# Bubble

A chat message in a bubble that shows who sent it.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Brand expressive keeps only the parts in use for one action and a story, not a part for one campaign. A back-and-forth chat is neither. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a>, <a href="./avatar">Avatar</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A back-and-forth conversation between people or with an assistant.
- **Not when:** Comments on a page or long text (use a message or a card).

Instead:

- [Message](./message.md): One message with its author and time, without the bubble shape.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add bubble
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Bubble reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Bubble has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
